heading: About Our Dental Practice
paragraphs: At Carolina Oaks Dental Care of Greenville, your smile is our top priority. Whether you are coming in for a routine six-month visit or in the middle of a dental emergency, our goal at this dental practice is to keep as comfortable as possible as we care for your teeth and gums.

We are committed to a preventive approach to dentistry, and we make patient education and preventive treatments the cornerstone of our dental practice. Your family can rest easy with our caring, professional staff, as we will always do our best to get to know each patient’s individual concerns, circumstances, and oral health needs.

We also provide cosmetic treatments to give you the flawless smile you deserve. Even the healthiest of teeth do not always look the way we want them to, as life’s wear and tear leaves its traces on our smiles. Cosmetic treatments, such as whitening, bonding, and porcelain veneers can help you achieve the smile you’ve always wanted.
